subject: Would my data fit the spatial-mark resight density modeling framework

messages.author: 7595ad705c6bb0b8
messages.subject: Would my data fit the spatial-mark resight density modeling framework
parts:
Hello all, 
I have data from a spatial capture resight study based on the iterative re-sighting study by Ritterson et al. 2021 and I have successfully estimated apparent survival like in the study. I now want to explore the possibility of obtaining density for the species within each study site and I thought about implementing the spatial mark-resight framework found in Kane et al. 2015 which is based on Chapters 18-19 by Royle et al.'s book. 

My question for this group is, based on this method where the trap locations are not fixed or constant across a study period (see image below with each point representing a resight point count and each color the occasion), would this data be inadequate for this framework? 

I thought about assigning a point by compiling all the points that fall within a 50 m hexagon (as the protocol of resighting iteratively makes you move ~50 m in search for your marked individuals) but this means that some cells will have more info than others. 

Any comments welcome
Fabi
PS. If this is not the right group for this let me know
